# asc_block_storage_attachment (Resource)

Manages a block storage attachment



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `block_storage_name` (String) The name of the block storage. Must be unique within the platform.
- `vm_name` (String) The name of the virtual machine. Must be unique within the platform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the block storage attachment
